articles.title: Welcome to Netrix!
articles.excerpt: Manage your mods and stay updated - Netrix 1.0.4 is here.
articles.content: Netrix 1.0.4 is now live! This custom launcher and mod manager is your all-in-one hub for the CrashCraft network and the upcoming modded server.
articles.author: StrataBytes

articles.title: Netrix Source Code Released
articles.excerpt: The full source code for Netrix is now available on GitHub for everyone to explore.
articles.content:
I'm happy to announce that the complete source code for Netrix is now publicly available on GitHub!

 This means you can now see exactly how Netrix works under the hood - from modpack management to server status integration. 

 I believe in transparency of the programs you run and this release is part of that!

                    Check it out here: https://github.com/StrataBytes/Netrix
articles.author: StrataBytes

articles.title: Server Test 1 is Live!
articles.excerpt: Join the first live server test and help prepare for the full launch.
articles.content: Server Test 1 is now officially live! Join a limited-time test session and help fine-tune the experience ahead of the real launch.
articles.author: StrataBytes

articles.title: Server Test 1 Concluded
articles.excerpt: Live server test has ended - thanks for participating!
articles.content: Server Test 1 has now concluded. Please wait for further updates as everything is being prepared for the full launch.
articles.author: StrataBytes

articles.title: Gearing up for the Full Launch!
articles.excerpt: Getting to the final stages of preparation for the server's launch.
articles.content:
The server is almost ready for its full launch! Right now, its just in the finalization stages of everything. There will be an update soon on the exact date and time, though this upcoming weekend is looking likely.

 Stay tuned for more information!
articles.author: StrataBytes

articles.title: Mark your Calendars!
articles.excerpt: Server launching this weekend! At 11:00AM MST on Saturday, August 2nd.
articles.content:
The server is officially launching this weekend! Join us at 11:00AM MST on Saturday, August 2nd for the grand opening.

 Get ready to explore, build and conquer. Can't wait to see you there!
articles.author: StrataBytes

articles.title: Server Test 2 is Live
articles.excerpt: Join the second live server test and help prepare for the full launch. - check the status page for more details.
articles.content: Server Test 2 is now officially live! Join a limited-time test session and help fine-tune the experience ahead of the real launch. - check the status page for more details.
articles.author: StrataBytes

articles.title: Server Test 2 is closed
articles.excerpt: Server Test 2 is now closed. If you played, please leave feedback on Discord!
articles.content:
Server Test 2 is now officially closed.   If you missed it, don't worry - the full launch is coming soon!

 If you played, please leave feedback on Discord!
articles.author: StrataBytes

articles.title: Get ready!
articles.excerpt: Server launching tomorrow at 11:00 AM Mountain Time / 12:00 PM Central Time!
articles.content:
The server is launching tomorrow at 11:00AM MST! Get ready to join us for the start of a new adventure and experience everything the modpack has to offer.

 Make sure you have the latest version of Netrix and the CrashCraft Modpack installed, as some adjustments may be made just before launch. See you there!
articles.author: StrataBytes

articles.title: Welcome to the Modded Server!
articles.excerpt: The modded server is now live, following the uptime schedule.
articles.content:
Im happy to say that the modded server is now live! It will be following the uptime schedule, so please check the status page for more details.

 Thank you all for your patience and support during the development and testing phases. I hope you enjoy exploring the new world and all the features it has to offer!
articles.author: StrataBytes

articles.title: CrashCraft Network Core Plans
articles.excerpt: Still working on that LTS configuration :/
articles.content: Its been a while since the CCN was online, but I really want to bring it back, with all legacy worlds included - not to play on as an event, but just to allow yall to check it out whenever, like a museum of sorts. The biggest hurdle yet to be cleared has been crunching down world sizes and optimizing everything to work on very low-powered hardware, so I wont be running multiple power-hungry servers with little to no interactions. Just though it put this here!
articles.author: StrataBytes

articles.title: Modded Server On Hold
articles.excerpt: Server on hold until intrest returns...
articles.content: Hello! Hope yall are doing well. Wanted to put an update here that the Modded Server is in an offline state for now. Minecraft is a game that goes in waves, so this is perfectly normal (plus the school year!). That said, everyhting will be waiting for a potential come-back in the future!
articles.author: StrataBytes
